mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ORDERS WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND del_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PRODUCT_REVIEWS (order_no, sku, member_id, rating, content, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{sku}, #{memberId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ROUND(AVG(rating), 1) AS avgRating, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 1 THEN 1 END), 0) AS rating1Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 2 THEN 1 END), 0) AS rating2Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 3 THEN 1 END), 0) AS rating3Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 4 THEN 1 END), 0) AS rating4Count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN rating = 5 THEN 1 END), 0) AS rating5Count FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS WHERE sku = #{sku} AND del_yn = 'N'
